verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own docs describe prompt caching: `cache_control` caches prompt prefixes to cut cost and latency, using automatic caching or explicit breakpoints with 5-minute or 1-hour TTLs. The pricing docs list per-model prices for 5m/1h cache writes and cache hits, so the ml-engineer can model the savings. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the actual cost and latency savings.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing

citations.quote: Cache prompt prefixes with `cache_control` to cut costs and latency, using automatic caching or explicit breakpoints with 5-minute or 1-hour TTLs.
